therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: aldesleukin with or without gp100 antigen vaccine
therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: IL-2 receptor and melanoma-associated gp100 antigen
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: IL-2 stimulates T-cell proliferation and activation; gp100 vaccine induces tumor-specific T-cell responses
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: enhancement of anti-tumor immune response through cytokine stimulation and antigen-specific vaccination
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with locally advanced or metastatic melanoma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: best response rate (partial response + complete response)

results.target_engagement_evidence: 7 patients in combination arm developed positive T-cell precursor assays vs 0 in aldesleukin alone arm
biomarker_changes: T-cell precursor reactivity increased in 7/85 patients receiving combination therapy vs 0/93 receiving aldesleukin alone
